- reissue the invoice with reverse-charge language and the VAT ID included
- advise whether Redwood can provide a one-time non-3DS payment link or a wire option while we sort the card with our bank

Hi Elena — thanks for the heads up and for sending the screenshot.

Quick plan so we don't block access:
1) I can reissue INV-5507 today with reverse-charge wording and include your VAT ID — I'll attach the PDF and send to your AR inbox. (Will be INV-5507-RC).
2) We can generate a one-time payment link that attempts authorization without forcing 3DS (if your acquirer allows exemption). I will include that link; note it is time-limited and a fallback only.
3) If you prefer a bank transfer, I can share our wire instructions and mark the invoice as 'pending wire' so your systems recognize it.

Laura / Dylan — can you:
- confirm that our finance team can reissue with the reverse-charge template (include VAT ID field) and regenerate INV-5507-RC?
- create a one-time payment link and set TTL to 48 hours; flag for manual collection if authorization fails.
- if acquirer returns code 05 repeatedly, what's our playbook for escalating a possible merchant-side exemption or submitting evidence for re-auth?

Elena — I'll start the reissue now and loop back with the link.

Best,

Thanks Marcus — we tried the one-time link you sent but the transaction was declined by our issuing bank with the following message from acquirer ops: 

---
Acquirer reference: ACQ-9921
Decline code: 05 (Do not honor)
Auth response: 3DS required by issuer; payer triggered fallback
Suggested action: request merchant evidence and attempt re-present with exemption or request customer's issuing bank to whitelist Redwood as a trusted merchant for this transaction.
---

We can provide a wire but that will take 2–3 business days; we wanted to avoid service disruption if possible. Also, your reissued invoice looks good but the finance team needs the invoice header to explicitly state 'Reverse-charge — VAT accounted for by customer'. Can you add that phrasing?

If you can escalate to Stripe/PSP for an exemption, please do — I'll include Acquirer Ops on this thread.

Elena
